tracks.title: Aurora
tracks.credit: 'Aurora' by Scott Buckley - released under CC-BY 4.0. www.scottbuckley.com.au

pieces.why: A low, level drone under the scenario and the problem; it stops dead 0.2 s before the cut: a breath of silence.
Cut in on Aurora's arrival (track 64.08 s) at 38 s, ahead of the narrator's "Fair Split" (38.5 s); bright under the solution, the demo and the comparison.
Aurora's calm, glittering tail, lower, under the architecture; from 160.6 s it lifts 5 dB over 1.0 s, holds 0.7 s and settles by 163.1 s (a gentle rise while the finished diagram runs, not a hit).
The last build: Aurora's final crest (track 300 s) lands on the last "Fair Split." (175.13 s) and rings out to 179 s.
